text:
maria: Noticed memory creeping on long-context plays this morning. KV cache 'used' keeps growing and slabs fragment. Profiling attached?

devin: Same. Seen on staging with 1.0.7 runtime. Growth correlated with >8k tokens sessions.

lee: I ran heap profile. Patterns: many small live blocks (~64-256B) and holes between 4KB slabs. Suspect allocator bucket mismatch.

sara: Any chance it's caused by batching heuristics holding onto KV refs longer? We changed max_prefetch in last deploy.

alex: Posting profiler snippet:
```
KV entries: total=1.2M
avg entry size=320
free fragments=72k
slab_count=512
fragmentation_ratio=0.28
```
Looks like fragmentation is ~28%

maria: Thanks. Can someone repro with stress harness that simulates long chat with repeated tool calls? I can instrument.

devin: I tried a run with max_prefetch=2 vs 0. Prefetch keeps refs alive across batches -> increases retention. patch attached.

lee: Allocator config we currently use: 
```
block_sizes=[64,128,256,512,1024,4096]
slab_size=1<<22
reuse_threshold=0.5
```
Change proposal: add 2048 and tune reuse_threshold->0.3

sara: Alternative: eager minor compaction when free_fragments > 50k and growth_rate > 1MB/s. Could be cheap if done async.

perf-bot: Perf alert: regression on p99 latency by +5% during compaction test at 2245679600. Link: https://perf/reports/2245

alex: Tradeoff: compaction pauses vs memory savings. We can do incremental relocation with background threads and limit copies per cycle.

maria: Propose RFC: 'slot-churn mitigation' -> combine (a) add 2K block size, (b) async incremental compaction, (c) batch-level ref counting fix. I'll sketch PR.

devin: If we add block size, we need to adjust kernel memalign for proper GPU mapping. Also watch quantized KV alignment.

lee: I'll run microbench: fragmentation sim with different block sets and measure GC throughput. ETA EOD.

sara: :thumbsup: We should add unit that simulates 12k token chats with tool calls; current tests stop at 6k.

maria: Cool. For now I'll roll a canary with reuse_threshold=0.3 and monitor. Anyone object?

alex: No objections. Let's include logging for compaction ops; log: compaction_start, moved_bytes, duration_ms, blocks_scanned.

maria: Great — will post canary IDs and perf dashboards here when ready.
